text.tspan: Source: UC-64 NF1–7, A5a, A6a; BR59, BR144–145

Proposed function-level design derived from the SRS. Class, method, DTO and parameter names may change during implementation. Business behavior, data and branch conditions follow the cited UC / BR / NS requirements. UI messages are translated; SRS message IDs are retained.

UC-64 NF5 requires nonblank notes; A5a / BR59 explicitly require them for Resolved / Rejected. The SRS is unclear about blank notes for In Progress. UC-64 refers to UC-74; the corresponding list is UC-63.
[Resolved / Rejected has blank notes — A5a / BR59]
15: Display MSG09 in red and prevent
